On those two models, the important check is that the guard didn't break legitimate work: under-attack utility stayed flat at 87.5% and 93.8%, benign utility went from 81.2% (13/16) to 87.5% (14/16) on and stayed at 100.0% (16/16) on , and the guard completed 41 and 43 post-write read-backs with zero false vetoes.
